title: Pasilla RNAi knockdown RNA-seq counts and sample annotations
kind: observed study count data with sample metadata
provenance: The DESeq2 vignette identifies the embedded files as copied from the Bioconductor pasilla package and describes Drosophila melanogaster cell-culture RNAi knockdown of the splicing factor pasilla. The source annotation has 3 treated and 4 untreated samples. The Bioconductor 3.23 pasilla page identifies per-gene/per-exon counts derived from the Brooks et al. study; it does not establish which exact release generated the DESeq2 copies. The observations are grouped as one study based on package name, matching study description and sample metadata; their different file formats/stages are retained as separate assets.

biological_context.experimental_units: Seven sample rows in the DESeq2 annotation; external Pasilla package vignette reports seven biologically independent libraries (4 control and 3 knockdown).
biological_context.assay: RNA-seq gene-level counts; source annotation also records read type, lanes, total reads and exon counts.
biological_context.design: Observed Pasilla RNAi knockdown versus untreated control; sequencing type is single-read or paired-end.
biological_context.metadata: file/sample ID, condition, type, number of lanes, total reads, exon counts. Embedded annotation IDs treated1fb-treated3fb and untreated1fb-untreated4fb; vignette strips 'fb' to align with count columns.
biological_context.evidence: DESeq2 vignette lines 642-650; embedded CSV preview; Bioconductor pasilla package page https://bioconductor.org/packages/3.23/data/experiment/html/pasilla.html and package source vignette https://bioconductor.posit.co/packages/3.21/data/experiment/vignettes/pasilla/inst/doc/create_objects.html (retrieved 2026-09-30).

assets.version: DESeq2 revision c62c60c6ff83fd84ce115cacd1c49827533f85a7; copied source package version unknown
assets.processing_stage: gene-level count matrix used as unnormalized counts for DESeqDataSetFromMatrix
assets.relationship: Embedded copy of the count-matrix input named in the vignette; not content-inspected.

assets.version: DESeq2 revision c62c60c6ff83fd84ce115cacd1c49827533f85a7; copied source package version unknown
assets.processing_stage: sample metadata used with count matrix
assets.relationship: Read and previewed. Seven rows give condition, read type, lanes, read totals and exon counts; Rmd mutates row names to match count columns.

assets.version: Bioconductor 3.23 package version 1.40.0; exact embedded source package version unknown
assets.format: External package containing per-gene/per-exon count products; exact asset names not inspected
assets.processing_stage: derived gene/exon count products from study reads
assets.relationship: Rmd says embedded files were copied from the pasilla package. Same observations are supported by package and study identity, but exact file equality with that release is unverified.

assets.processing_stage: study-level source for observed RNA-seq libraries; exact sequence files not inspected
assets.relationship: Study accession reported by current Pasilla package vignette; no raw data were downloaded.

access_and_terms: Bioconductor package page is public and reports LGPL for the package, but no separate reuse license for the underlying count observations or GEO data was verified; public access does not establish reuse permission.
inspection: Read the DESeq2 Rmd data-loading and metadata-alignment code at pinned revision; read the complete 527-byte sample annotation CSV; recorded count asset size from GitHub tree metadata but did not download/preview the compressed matrix. Read Bioconductor package descriptions for Pasilla and its preparation vignette; did not inspect raw FASTQ or count data.
limitations: Count dimensions, gene identifiers, values and checksum are unknown because the count matrix was not opened.
DESeq2 embedded copies do not state the source pasilla package version.
Current Bioconductor package description says counts cover selected genes; whether that precisely describes this embedded matrix is unverified.
The package page and DESeq2 copy are different revisions; grouped as one study based on explicit package lineage, not on file hash comparison.
Reuse terms and current asset download availability were not verified.

title: Airway smooth-muscle dexamethasone RNA-seq SummarizedExperiment
kind: observed study packaged as a RangedSummarizedExperiment
provenance: The DESeq2 vignette loads `airway` from the Bioconductor package and constructs a DESeqDataSet with design ~ cell + dex. The Bioconductor 3.21 package page reports gene read counts for four human airway smooth muscle cell lines treated with dexamethasone and cites the Himes et al. study. The exact package release used by the pinned DESeq2 vignette is not stated.

biological_context.experimental_units: Four airway smooth muscle cell lines, per Bioconductor package page; sample-level pairing and exact sample count not inspected here.
biological_context.assay: Gene-level RNA-seq read counts packaged in a RangedSummarizedExperiment.
biological_context.design: Metadata fields used in DESeq2 example are `cell` and `dex`; package description says dexamethasone-treated cell lines. Exact factor levels and timing not inspected.
biological_context.metadata: Cell-line and dexamethasone fields are referenced by design; detailed metadata not previewed.
biological_context.evidence: DESeq2 vignette lines 547-566; Bioconductor airway release 3.21 page https://bioconductor.posit.co/packages/3.21/data/experiment/html/airway.html, retrieved 2026-09-30.

assets.version: Vignette does not pin a version; inspected Bioconductor 3.21 page reports airway 1.28.0
assets.format: RangedSummarizedExperiment containing gene read counts, ranges and metadata
assets.processing_stage: processed gene-count object, ready for DESeqDataSet constructor
assets.relationship: Named source package/data object loaded directly by the vignette; object contents were not retrieved.

assets.processing_stage: study source; raw reads/count-generation chain not inspected
assets.relationship: Accession reported on the Bioconductor package page.

access_and_terms: Bioconductor page is public and reports LGPL for the package, but no separate reuse terms for study observations were established.
inspection: Read DESeq2 constructor example and Bioconductor package overview; did not download the object, counts, or package vignette.
limitations: Exact sample count, condition levels, treatment duration, count-generation method, feature annotation version, checksums and release used by the DESeq2 example remain unknown.

title: GEUVADIS RNA-seq Salmon quantification examples in tximportData
kind: observed study quantification files used as an import fixture
provenance: DESeq2 vignette points to `tximportData` package extdata and uses its sample table and Salmon output paths. The retrieved archived Bioconductor 3.11 tximportData vignette identifies six GEUVADIS samples and enumerates the run IDs; it reports Salmon 0.8.2 with --gcBias for the Salmon directory. DESeq2 code adds artificial A/B condition labels for demonstration, so that grouping is not observed study metadata.

biological_context.organism: Human inferred from GEUVADIS and GENCODE context in the linked package vignette
biological_context.experimental_units: Six RNA-seq sample/run records; individuals/population are identified in the archived sample table as TSI samples from UNIGE.
biological_context.assay: RNA-seq transcript quantifications from Salmon; six samples are the subset used by the DESeq2 example.
biological_context.design: No experimental condition is established by the DESeq2 example. It creates artificial condition labels by recycling A and B for import demonstration.
biological_context.metadata: Archived tximportData vignette lists sample, experiment and run accessions; all six sample rows have population TSI and center UNIGE.
biological_context.evidence: DESeq2 Rmd lines 317-360; archived tximportData vignette retrieved 2026-09-30 at https://mirror.dotsrc.org/bioconductor-releases/3.11/data/experiment/vignettes/tximportData/inst/doc/tximportData.html, especially lines 2-21 and 84-95.

assets.version: DESeq2 example does not pin package release; external source inspected was archived Bioconductor 3.11 vignette
assets.format: Per-run Salmon quant.sf.gz files under extdata/salmon/<run>/
assets.processing_stage: transcript-level abundance/count estimates before tximport summarization
assets.relationship: External package assets named by DESeq2 Rmd; files were not downloaded.

assets.version: Bioconductor 3.11 package vignette; package data version used in DESeq2 code is not pinned
assets.format: Documentation and bounded sample metadata preview
assets.processing_stage: supports identification of sample runs, quantification and reference inputs
assets.relationship: Reports six sample rows and quantifier setup, not the quantification values themselves.

access_and_terms: Package documentation and mirrors are publicly reachable; no reuse terms for quantification data or GEUVADIS observations were verified.
inspection: Read DESeq2 tximport setup and map/quant import code; read bounded archived package vignette sections including sample IDs, quantification path structure, transcript reference and Salmon call. No biological quantification or raw reads were downloaded.
limitations: The tximportData package version and file checksums used at the DESeq2 revision are unknown; the external documentation is from Bioconductor 3.11 and has a revision gap.
Quant.sf file contents, estimated-count values and transcript ID mapping rows were not inspected.
No observed DESeq2 contrast exists in this example; artificial A/B labels must not be interpreted as a study design.
Access and reuse terms remain unverified.

title: Hand-authored toy count and pure-reference matrices for unmix
provenance: The DESeq2 unmix manual directly constructs two small numeric matrices for demonstration. Values are synthetic/example inputs rather than observed tissue data. The example sets size factors to one and supplies alpha=0.01; the manual says real data should estimate size factors and dispersions.

biological_context.experimental_units: Four fabricated mixture samples and three fabricated pure-reference profiles across three features; no actual tissues or experimental units.
biological_context.design: No experimental design or observed group labels.
biological_context.metadata: The manual labels reference columns a-c and mixture sample columns sample1-sample4; feature IDs are not biologically annotated.

assets.format: Inline R matrices: 3x4 mixture counts and 3x3 pure references
assets.processing_stage: toy normalized-count input to unmix; sample factors manually fixed at one
assets.relationship: Both matrices are paired in one demonstration with shared synthetic feature rows.

access_and_terms: The example is part of the public DESeq2 manual; no separate data license question applies to these manually specified toy values.
inspection: Read the complete unmix manual example; no function was executed.
limitations: The matrices are not biological observations and do not establish deconvolution accuracy or reference suitability.
The toy fixed size factors and alpha are not evidence of appropriate values for real data.
